notes_for_editor: Weakest of the three. The only tower evidence is one list entry, 'tally mtn', with no register number, height, date or notes. The coordinates and the 1,522 ft elevation match the Haralson County summit on Wikipedia (USGS-based), so the record's point is a real summit; no source read says a tower stands or stood on it. Reads with no tower text: the Haralson County GFC page, a MountainZone summit page, and the Wikipedia article. A Haralson County E911 Facebook search snippet mentions a woods fire on the side of Tally Mountain, with no tower named; not fetched and not used. Two web searches on the Haralson tower found nothing else. Editor should decide whether the record should stay as a tower or be reviewed as a possible list error (kind 'tower' on an unconfirmed summit). No correction is proposed because no source contradicts the record. Story is 71 words, well under the 120-word floor, because the evidence stops at the list entry and the summit article.
